title: 微信被曝内测「小微 AI 社交」功能：AI 替你找好友聊天、约饭
content: WeChat is testing an AI social feature called "Xiao Wei," enabling AI agents to interact on users' behalf for tasks like scheduling. The platform is also piloting a native AI assistant accessible from the main interface. This assistant can manage WeChat features, launch mini-programs, search content, generate creative work, and summarize conversations to suggest replies. Users retain final decision-making authority and can authorize or override the AI’s actions.

title: 张一鸣督导，字节跳动拟推出实时空间视频生成 AI 模型
content: ByteDance is preparing to launch a new AI model capable of real-time spatial video generation. The technology targets applications in robotics and autonomous systems, positioning the company to compete with firms like Meta and Alphabet. Founder Zhang Yiming oversees the development process, coordinating cross-departmental efforts and allocating substantial AI resources and computing power. The model is expected to debut as early as next month, though the exact release timeline remains subject to change.

title: 宇树科技：首次实现人形机器人全自主搏击
content: Unitree Robotics unveiled its UnifoLM-X2-1.0 model, enabling its humanoid robot to perform fully autonomous sparring. This advancement overcomes critical bottlenecks in instantaneous planning, decision-making, and dynamic interaction execution. The robot demonstrates high-dynamic capabilities, strong interaction, and real-time predictive planning. Unitree asserts that these results confirm the foundational feasibility of large-scale deployment for world-model-driven humanoid robots.

title: 闻泰科技辟谣「创始人跑路海外」：系不实消息，已对抹黑行为提起诉讼
content: Wingtech announced that online rumors claiming founder Zhang Xuezheng defrauded investors and fled overseas are unfounded. The company condemned the dissemination of misinformation, which it says misled the public. Wingtech has initiated legal proceedings for defamation, with a Beijing court accepting the case. Additionally, the company filed a separate complaint against a foreign executive accused of an unauthorized power grab. Management emphasized its commitment to using legal channels to rectify false narratives and protect its reputation against malicious online smear campaigns.

title: 星宇股份：总经理周晓萍扣薪12个月，人力资源总监免职
content: Changzhou Star Auto Lamp Co., Ltd. implemented management penalties following an improper response to new graduate recruitment in early August, which caused significant impact. General Manager Zhou Xiaoping faced a 12-month pay deduction. Deputy General Manager Li Shujun had his duties adjusted and received a 6-month pay deduction. Human Resources Director Yu Zhiming was dismissed, while HR Department Head Li Mei was demoted and reassigned. These effective decisions aim to enforce accountability within the company’s leadership team.

title: 千问办公推出「多人工作台」
content: Alibaba's Qianwen Office has launched the industry's first multi-user workbench. Users can describe requirements to generate web pages supporting up to one hundred online collaborators. This tool handles complex business processes, such as event organization and enterprise collaboration, while eliminating the high costs and delays associated with traditional software development. It serves as a cost-effective solution for SaaS procurement and custom development challenges. The feature is accessible through the functional entry point at the bottom of the Qianwen Office homepage.

title: 华为 HarmonyOS 7 正式发布
content: Huawei officially released HarmonyOS 7, introducing significant upgrades to its underlying architecture. The operating system enhances capabilities across five core dimensions: spatial aesthetics, intelligence, performance, security, and interconnectivity. A notable feature of this update is the elevation of the Xiaoyi voice assistant to a system-level intelligent agent, further integrating advanced AI functions into the user experience.

title: 英伟达拟斥 30 亿美元投穆拉蒂创办的 Thinking Machines Lab
content: NVIDIA is negotiating a $2.5 to $3 billion investment in Thinking Machines Lab, co-founded by former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati, which has a $40 billion pre-money valuation. This move complements NVIDIA’s recent acquisition of Hugging Face and a $6 billion deal with Poolside. By securing investments in frontier model developers and open-source platforms, NVIDIA aims to construct an integrated ecosystem spanning chips, models, and fine-tuning tools. These strategic actions reflect a broader effort to lock in future computational demands and transition from being a mere infrastructure supplier to a central architect of the AI model layer.
